verdict.rationale: The SDK is a library (spawns a local claude CLI subprocess) rather than a hosted/managed runtime; docs provide production deployment guidance for self-hosting on Docker/Kubernetes/sandbox providers with scaling, session persistence and multi-tenant isolation, which lets an engineering lead build their own API wrapper, but there is no evidence of a first-party managed runtime service that auto-provisions an API endpoint. Missing for 10: a vendor-managed hosting/runtime offering (e.g., Anthropic-hosted endpoint), independent confirmation of production deployments, and any turnkey 'deploy and get an API URL' workflow.
